title: Restore dropped SRD Skills proficiency prose after embedded skill list
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P1.
- rule:skills silently drops operative prose after the embedded skill-to-ability list.
- Existing rule:skills text ends at approximately: "...examples of how to use a skill associated with an ability" on p. 77 and carries structured skillsByAbility.
- Missing p. 78 prose resumes after the list and explains what skill proficiency means: an individual can add proficiency bonus to ability checks involving that skill; without proficiency the individual makes a normal ability check; it also includes the climbing-a-cliff example.

Root cause hypothesis from Fable:
- Parser does not resume prose capture after an embedded bullet/list region.
- The unaccounted=0 source-region ledger gate misses the loss because the region is owned by rule:skills, even though the post-list prose is not actually emitted.

Why it matters:
- This is a core D&D rule for what skill proficiency does.
- Primary DM lookup loses the canonical rule explanation.
- Deterministic ability-check and character proficiency tooling cannot cite/ground the rule from the pack.

Acceptance criteria:
- rule:skills includes the post-list p. 78 prose after the skillsByAbility embedded list.
- The structured skillsByAbility mapping remains intact.
- Add regression coverage for prose resuming after embedded lists/tables inside a rule region.
- Add or extend a source-coverage/source-region gate so owned regions only count as represented when their prose is emitted or deliberately transformed into a structured equivalent.
- Regenerate committed SRD artifacts and update freeze metadata/thaw note as required.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #383: parseRules re-flows post-bullet prose from excluded bullet captions into the enclosing rule; rule:skills carries the p78 proficiency prose; region ledger reclassifies to record:rule:skills with containment guard. General owned-region gate remains 18.9.2.
